description: This file defines a report for sales register in ERPNext, including functions to fetch invoice data, compute totals, and generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the sales register report with optional filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal function that performs the core report generation logic.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report columns based on invoice data and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Fetches invoice records from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_invoice_income_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of invoice income amounts per account.

methods.name: get_internal_invoice_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of internal invoice unrealized profit/loss amounts.

methods.name: get_invoice_tax_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of tax amounts per invoice and account.

methods.name: get_invoice_so_dn_map
methods.description: Maps sales orders and delivery notes to invoices.

methods.name: get_invoice_cc_wh_map
methods.description: Maps cost centers and warehouses to invoices.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Retrieves mode of payment details for invoices.
